title: Brightness edits stay with their animation, and a brightness zoom
summary: A brightness gesture of the app, a drag of the slider, a typed value or a press of Override for this animation, is bound when it begins to its target, its animation and its mode, and finishes for that animation even when the playlist moves on meanwhile: today the app drops the edit without a word and turns the rest of the gesture into a change of the default, which the board does not keep after a restart, so a saved animation comes back with its old value. The panel says what was saved for which animation, takes no new gesture for a second after it moves to another animation, and says that the default is not kept. A Brightness zoom bar above the slider, with pins Start and End, sets the range the slider moves through and is kept on the phone. App only; no command, core, firmware or emulator change. Implemented (tasks 1-5, and the bridge B-1 that keeps a held row scrolling under the taller panel) and delivered (task 6) in open PR #70, built on PR #68's branch; not merged, and the owner's phone check is open.
